column1: # HISTORICAL: record of the one-off move from the author's private tree to this repository. No script
# or CI uses it; kept so the stage can be followed. Names in it are the names of that time.
# Stage E2b: English names for PlatformIO environments, files, identifiers and script options.
# Format: kind TAB old TAB new TAB where / note. Kinds: env, file, ident, flag.
# 'file' rows are read by tools/check_comment_only.py (a renamed file is compared with its old name).
# Not renamed in E2b on purpose (they are text that ends up in the test references, stage E3):
#   console lines and API codes, golden_stream options passed by run_host_tests.sh (--przestoj, --zgub,
#   --bez, --raport-skrzynka appear in the headers of test_host/expected/golden_stream*.txt),
# Not renamed until the owner decides the project name (stage E13): product values in project.json.
